name: PRISMA Commercial Package Hygiene Policy
purpose: Prevent dev examples, fixtures, handoff evidence, internal audits, and legacy TABLET_PC_REQUIRED naming from shipping in customer commercial payloads.
canonical_rule: PC gobierna si existe, pero es opcional
